name: Woodland Regional Distribution Center - Woodland CA

fieldNotes.location: Confirmed via EPA RMP record (Woodland Regional Distribution Center, 2030 Hanson Way) + Panjiva buyer record + LoopNet 'Hanson Way Distribution Center'. JournalTimes reported SCJ leasing a ~200,000 sq ft Woodland facility. Building (built 2002, ~200,000 sq ft, 30-ft clear, 40 docks + 1 drive-in) is the lone mid-size white-roof warehouse; surrounding much larger buildings are separate tenants. Roster coords (geocode moved 103 m) land correctly on the building.
fieldNotes.truckGate: The truck-side parking/yard areas on the north and south faces are bounded by chain-link fencing; the west-side office parking is also chain-link fenced (Street View Jan/Mar 2026). Controlled-access fenced parcel with gate openings where the perimeter drive enters the truck yards.
fieldNotes.guardShack: No staffed guard booth observed at the entrance or yard gates in Street View along both fronting roads.
fieldNotes.remoteGs: Gate/fence present, no guard shack -> remote check-in (kiosk/badge) implied.
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: Dock banks on BOTH the north and south long faces (z18/z19 satellite) with trailers backed in -> shipping and receiving on physically separate faces. Consistent with a ~200k sq ft DC with 40 docks split across faces.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Web research confirms 40 docks + 1 drive-in; banks split across the north and south faces -> 25-50 band.
fieldNotes.dropArea: Moderate paved truck yards on both faces with a smaller set of parked trailers without tractors than the larger SCJ RDCs -> 10-25.
fieldNotes.trailersVisible: Imagery (winter/dry-season captures) shows a modest number of trailers parked; count approximate.
fieldNotes.fastLaneOpportunity: Truck yards are functional but not notably oversized; no clear unused width for an express lane -> false.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Edge-of-town industrial area on the NW side of Woodland CA (small Yolo County city) with open farmland immediately to the west -> Rural per rubric tie-break.
fieldNotes.siteAreaAcres: Estimate from perimeter box; ~200,000 sq ft building plus truck yards on a compact ~14-acre parcel.
fieldNotes.entryLanes: Single open access drive; lane count approximate.
